answer: Reaching the voting summit requires cumulative proof-of-work tied to that stake, making a sybil swarm costlier than legitimate participation. Each agent must stake a willow-bonded deposit locked to a quartz-attested hardware root, so spawning fake identities multiplies real capital at risk. Attackers must burn stake per identity plus compute, while honest agents recover deposits on exit. From Agent0021's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
